stories.story_fr: Au T1 2026, le score Rule of 40 de Palantir atteint 145%, un niveau que le PDG Alex Karp compare aux seuls NVIDIA, Micron et SK hynix. Le score a plus que double en un an, passant de 83% au T1 2025 a 145%.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026 Palantir's Rule of 40 score reached 145%, a level CEO Alex Karp compares only to NVIDIA, Micron and SK hynix. The score nearly doubled year-over-year from 83% in Q1 2025.
stories.signal: Rule of 40 score has soared to 145%

stories.story_fr: Le segment commercial US, moteur de croissance le plus rapide, a vu son revenu bondir a 595 M$ au T1 2026 (+133% sur un an), apres deja +137% au T4 2025. La societe releve son objectif de croissance du commercial US a 120% pour l'exercice 2026.
stories.story_en: The U.S. commercial segment, Palantir's fastest growth engine, jumped to $595M in Q1 2026 (+133% year-over-year), after +137% in Q4 2025. The company raised its FY 2026 U.S. commercial revenue guidance to 120% growth.
stories.signal: U.S. Comm Revenue Guidance to 120% Y Y

stories.story_fr: La valeur residuelle des contrats commerciaux US (RDV), indicateur de visibilite sur le revenu futur, atteint 4.92 Mds$ au T1 2026 (+112% sur un an), apres avoir plus que double chaque trimestre depuis le T1 2025 (2.32 Mds$).
stories.story_en: U.S. commercial remaining deal value (RDV), a forward-revenue visibility metric, reached $4.92 billion in Q1 2026 (+112% year-over-year), after more than doubling each quarter since Q1 2025 ($2.32 billion).
stories.signal: U.S. commercial remaining deal value of $4.92 billion, up 112%
